home.seoText: tools24.jp provides free browser-based tools for developers and professionals working with Japanese systems. JSON formatting, image compression, character counting, regex testing, dummy data generation, and more — all running entirely in your browser with no data sent to servers.

furigana-converter.title: Furigana Converter
furigana-converter.description: Add furigana (reading aids) to kanji. Convert to hiragana, katakana, or romaji.
furigana-converter.culturalContext: Furigana (振り仮名) are small phonetic characters printed above kanji to show the correct reading. This tool automatically adds furigana to Japanese text — essential for Japanese language learners, document editing, and creating accessible reading materials.

zenkaku-hankaku.title: Fullwidth ↔ Halfwidth Converter
zenkaku-hankaku.description: Convert between fullwidth and halfwidth characters
zenkaku-hankaku.culturalContext: Japanese text uses two character widths: fullwidth (全角) for standard Japanese characters and halfwidth (半角) for ASCII-compatible characters. Many Japanese business systems require specific width formats for data entry — this tool converts between them instantly.

mojibake-fixer.title: Mojibake Fixer
mojibake-fixer.description: Detect and fix garbled Japanese text caused by encoding mismatches
mojibake-fixer.culturalContext: Mojibake (文字化け) refers to garbled text that appears when Japanese text is read with the wrong character encoding. This is extremely common when working with legacy Japanese files (Shift_JIS, EUC-JP) or transferring data between systems with different default encodings.

digital-stamp.title: Digital Seal Maker (Hanko)
digital-stamp.description: Create digital Japanese seals (hanko) for documents
digital-stamp.culturalContext: In Japan, personal seals (判子/印鑑, hanko) are traditionally used instead of signatures to approve official documents, contracts, and forms. This tool creates digital versions for use in PDFs and electronic documents. Note: seals created here have no legal authority for official submissions.

wareki-converter.title: Japanese Era Converter
wareki-converter.description: Convert between Japanese imperial eras (Reiwa/Heisei/Showa) and Western calendar / UNIX time
wareki-converter.culturalContext: Japan uses a unique calendar system based on imperial eras (元号, gengō). The current era is Reiwa (令和), which began on May 1, 2019. Previous eras include Heisei (平成), Showa (昭和), Taisho (大正), and Meiji (明治). Era-based dates appear on government forms, contracts, ID cards, and official documents throughout Japan.

home.title: tools24.jp — Free Online Developer Tools for Japan
home.description: Free browser-based tools for developers working with Japanese systems. JSON formatter, regex tester, Japanese era converter, furigana converter, dummy data generator, and more. No sign-up, no data sent to servers.

jsonFormatter.title: JSON Formatter & Validator — tools24.jp
jsonFormatter.description: Format, validate, and convert JSON online. Supports minification, CSV/YAML/XML/TypeScript conversion, diff comparison. Free, no sign-up, nothing sent to servers.

regexTester.title: Regex Tester — Live Regular Expression Testing — tools24.jp
regexTester.description: Test regular expressions in real time. Live match highlighting, Japanese data presets (postal codes, phone numbers, email), and plain-language explanations. Free, browser-based.

cronBuilder.title: Cron Expression Builder — Visual Cron Scheduler — tools24.jp
cronBuilder.description: Build cron expressions visually. See the next execution time in JST, get plain-language schedule descriptions. For server cron jobs, GitHub Actions, AWS EventBridge, and more.

warekiConverter.title: Japanese Era (Wareki) ↔ Western Calendar Converter — tools24.jp
warekiConverter.description: Convert between Japanese imperial era dates (Reiwa, Heisei, Showa, Taisho, Meiji) and Western calendar, UNIX timestamps, or ISO 8601. Essential for Japanese government forms and contracts.

encodeDecode.title: Encode / Decode Toolkit — Base64, URL, JWT, Hash, Unicode — tools24.jp
encodeDecode.description: Base64 encoding/decoding, URL encoding, JWT decoding, MD5/SHA hash generation, and Unicode conversion — all in your browser. Supports Japanese text and Shift_JIS/EUC-JP encoding.

dummyData.title: Dummy Data Generator — Japanese Test Data — tools24.jp
dummyData.description: Generate realistic Japanese test data: names, addresses, phone numbers, email, company names, My Number, and more — 22 field types. Export as CSV, JSON, TSV, or SQL. Nothing sent to servers.

characterCounter.title: Character Counter — Count Characters, Words & Lines — tools24.jp
characterCounter.description: Count characters, words, and lines in real time. Fullwidth/halfwidth distinction, manuscript paper conversion, Twitter character count. Free, browser-based.

furiganaConverter.title: Furigana Converter — Add Reading Aids to Kanji — tools24.jp
furiganaConverter.description: Automatically add furigana (reading aids) to Japanese kanji text. Convert to hiragana, katakana, or romaji. For Japanese learners, document editing, and accessible content creation.

imageCompressor.title: Image Compressor & Resizer — PNG/JPG/WebP — tools24.jp
imageCompressor.description: Compress and resize PNG, JPG, and WebP images in your browser. Batch processing, quality control, size presets. No sign-up, no data sent to servers.
